# Kept

> Kept is an iPhone app (with a web version) that scans greeting cards, both the printed front and the handwritten message inside, and keeps them in a private, searchable archive sorted by who sent the card and when. Made by Liha LLC. Free on the App Store.

Kept is for people who keep the cards they receive (birthday, holiday, wedding, sympathy, thank-you, cards from parents and grandparents) and want the handwriting preserved without keeping a shoebox. It is not a card-making or card-sending service.

## What it does

- Scans a card from a phone photo: finds the edges, straightens and crops it. No scanner needed.
- Keeps the inside of the card (the handwritten note) together with the front, so the message is never separated from the card.
- Reads the handwriting into text automatically, so a note can be searched and re-read; the text can be corrected by hand and translated into the phone's language.
- Files every card by sender, recipient, date and occasion, and finds any of them in seconds.
- Shares a collection with family members (view-only), by email invitation.
- Exports the whole archive as a zip backup at any time; anyone can open a backup in the free web viewer without an account.
- Private by design: no feed, no followers, no ads, no selling of data. Only the owner and the people they invite can see the cards.

## Availability

- iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809942529 (App Store name: "Kept: Greeting Card Archive")
- Web (Android, desktop): https://kept.cards/app.html — sign in with a Google account or Apple ID
- Web viewer for exported backups (no account): https://kept.cards/viewer.html

## Price

Free to download, and free to use for an archive of up to 20 cards, with every feature included: scanning, search, sharing, export and handwriting transcription. Kept Unlimited, an optional subscription at $19.99 a year, removes the card limit. There is no advertising and no sale of data.

## Good questions Kept answers

- How do I store or organize old greeting cards without keeping the boxes?
- Is there an app to scan greeting cards, including the handwritten inside?
- How can I keep a parent's or grandparent's handwriting from cards?
- How do I share saved cards with family?
- How can I digitize birthday cards, Christmas cards, wedding cards?
- Is there a free app for scanning greeting cards?
